actor_rows.name: Vasko
actor_rows.speaker: Vasko
actor_rows.text: Hello, small one.

actor_rows.name: Vasko
actor_rows.speaker: Vasko
actor_rows.text: Doctor told me not to open the door for anyone. But doesn't give me enough food. Wants me to work for him but lets me starve. Not funny. You know what? Bring me some food and I will open the door for you. ...

actor_rows.name: Vasko
actor_rows.speaker: Vasko
actor_rows.text: Bugs ... so tasty but I ate all of them down here. And mushrooms. They are most delicious when spiced and cooked. Mushroom pie! That's it. I want the meat of ten bugs and a mushroom pie.

actor_rows.name: Vasko
actor_rows.speaker: Vasko
actor_rows.text: Hello, small one.

actor_rows.name: Vasko
actor_rows.speaker: Vasko
actor_rows.text: Mmmm, smells delicious! Thank you! You can pass now - and I can eat now.

actor_rows.name: Avan
actor_rows.speaker: Avan
actor_rows.text: Greetings, dear ... visitor?

actor_rows.name: Avan
actor_rows.speaker: Avan
actor_rows.text: Look, Doctor Marrow's experiments are ground-breaking, no doubt. But some of the mutants he created are quite dangerous. I'm talking about the rhindeers in particular. ...

actor_rows.name: Avan
actor_rows.speaker: Avan
actor_rows.text: They are a threat to the laboratory staff and equipment and there are far too many of them. Please kill one hundred of them and I will open the door for you. Then you can discuss all possible scientific discrepancies with Doctor Marrow himself.

actor_rows.name: Avan
actor_rows.speaker: Avan
actor_rows.text: Greetings, dear ... visitor?

actor_rows.name: Avan
actor_rows.speaker: Avan
actor_rows.text: Thank you for your assistance. Feel free to pass now and discuss all possible scientific discrepancies with Doctor Marrow himself.

actor_rows.name: Aletta
actor_rows.speaker: Aletta
actor_rows.text: Greetings, dear guest.

actor_rows.name: Aletta
actor_rows.speaker: Aletta
actor_rows.text: Doctor Marrow claims all of our scientific achievements for himself. But it's me who did most of the research. In fact, this is my work. But now he withholds most of the essential research papers, hiding them from me. ...

actor_rows.name: Aletta
actor_rows.speaker: Aletta
actor_rows.text: I want those research papers. Listen: There are three smaller labs out there in the caves where you can find some important information. ...

actor_rows.name: Aletta
actor_rows.speaker: Aletta
actor_rows.text: Please take the inkwell and feather from my writing desk and copy the research notes on the note boards there. Additionally, there has to be a book with transcripts that I need, too. ...

actor_rows.name: Aletta
actor_rows.speaker: Aletta
actor_rows.text: But perhaps he has hidden it somewhere, I'm not sure. At last, there are some research records he considered worthless and ignorantly threw them away. I hope, you will still find them in one of the rubbish piles down here. ...

actor_rows.name: Aletta
actor_rows.speaker: Aletta
actor_rows.text: Bring me those research records, the copied notes from the smaller labs and the transcript book. Then I will open the door for you.

actor_rows.name: Aletta
actor_rows.speaker: Aletta
actor_rows.text: Greetings, dear guest.

actor_rows.name: Aletta
actor_rows.speaker: Aletta
actor_rows.text: There they are! Thank you very much! Now you may pass.

actor_rows.name: Ivora
actor_rows.speaker: Ivora
actor_rows.text: Hello, small one.

actor_rows.name: Ivora
actor_rows.speaker: Ivora
actor_rows.text: The lab assistants like to call us monsters. But Doctor Marrow is the real monster here: He transformed me against my will! I want him to pay for it, sure. But I also want my family to know what happened to me. ...

actor_rows.name: Ivora
actor_rows.speaker: Ivora
actor_rows.text: Hello, small one.

actor_rows.name: Ivora
actor_rows.speaker: Ivora
actor_rows.text: Thank you for delivering my letter. You may pass the door now. Please make Doctor Marrow pay for his misdeeds.

actor_rows.name: Ivora
actor_rows.speaker: Ivora
actor_rows.text: Hello, small one.

actor_rows.name: Ivora
actor_rows.speaker: Ivora
actor_rows.text: You did *what*? Grrrrm. Now I have to write a new one. But look at those claws ... No, wait, *you* will write it. Listen, I dictate ...

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: Greetings, dear visitor.

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: I was working for Doctor Marrow for a long time. And once I believed in what we were doing: scientific progress and so on. But now, things are going too far. Those experiments are clearly unethical and condemnable. ...

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: We have to stop this. But before I open the door for you, I must make sure that you are not one of those who only want to benefit from his research. Prove your honesty by healing some of the creatures down here. ...

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: Unfortunately, most of the test objects are beyond remedy. But the five victims in the test tubes in this part of the laboratory can still be saved. You need an anti-mutagen and luckily, the ingredients are not too intricate. ...

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: For one dose of anti-mutagen, draw some nutrient solution from one of the liquid containers around here and pour it into the cauldron right here. Then you need the yolk of a monster egg. ...

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: You will find quite a few of them in the caves down here. Best take an egg cracker and a spoon to break the eggs and collect the yolk. You may find the needed tools in one of the crates here in the lab. ...

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: Add the yolk to the nutrient solution in the cauldron. And at last you need hydra herbs. Just pick them from the hydra corms that grow down here and add them to the cauldron. ...

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: Then you have to infuse the five test tubes in the lab here with the anti-mutagen and the poor test objects will be healed. They will not transform into monsters.

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: Greetings, dear visitor.

actor_rows.name: Geoffray
actor_rows.speaker: Geoffray
actor_rows.text: Thank you in the names of five creatures who won't be transformed into monsters now. Now, pass the door and put an end to Doctor Marrow's schemes.

actor_rows.name: Gnomoney
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomoney
actor_rows.text: Hi Jogador

actor_rows.name: Gnomoney
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomoney
actor_rows.text: I would like you to enter the area and dig out the treasure. Shovels can be found in a chest there!

actor_rows.name: Gnomonster
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomonster
actor_rows.text: Hi Jogador

actor_rows.name: Gnomonster
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomonster
actor_rows.text: In this remarkable area these crystal splinters can be salvaged. For that reason you have to slay all creatures there first.

actor_rows.name: Gnomonster
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomonster
actor_rows.text: These monsters seem to behave in an extraordinary way. All of them can be seen as one huge organism, like a swarm.

actor_rows.name: Gnomonster
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomonster
actor_rows.text: They bear a certain kind of immortality. If you kill one of them, it will be in resurrected within a short time.

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Hello! Welcome to the war soldier!

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: I wish I could accompany you on your mission but i have to stay on my post.

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: You will have to guide a gnomish explorer to some ancient ruins, wait until he finished his research and return him home ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: It will be your task to protect him from all kinds of hazards. Should he die your mission failed. ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: If you die, we will deny al knowledge about you and your mission.

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: Hi Jogador

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: Right now I am trying to find the melting point of this wax but it's very exhausting to keep the fire going and supply enough of the substance. I really need some help.

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: Maybe you could actually help me! It's a bit complicated though. Someone needs to tend to the fire while someone else needs to find samples. ...

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: There is not much room for failure but I will make it worth your time! ...

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: If you think you can do what needs to be done got to my study with this lever here.

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: You need to keep the fire going. Best is to add firewood every other twenty seconds and the wax needs to be added every other 30 seconds.

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: The wax can only be collected at certain times. Black blisters show where to pick up some pieces.

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: If you fail to keep to the strict time schedule, my research will be for nothing!

actor_rows.name: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.speaker: Gnomnerdia
actor_rows.text: In case you do succeed to help me I will make sure to help you, too. I do happen to have some of the artefacts you need!

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Hello! Welcome to the war soldier!

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: I wish I could accompany you on your mission but i have to stay on my post.

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: You will have to fish in lava pools for lost data crystals. ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: You'll be provided with appropriate fishing rods. Kill the instable fire there to get something heat resistant and sticky as some kind of bait. ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: The good spots to fish at can be recognized by flames on the lava! ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Be aware of the lava eruptions that occur regularly. You'll have to find some cover to be save. Bad news is, there IS no natural cover in the cave! ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Perhaps you can use the remains of some critters as a makeshift obstacle. ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: The data collector crystal that we provided will acquire the stored information of data crystal on its own. On him you can see how much date you collected!

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Hello! Welcome to the war soldier!

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: I wish I could accompany you on your mission but i have to stay on my post.

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: You will have to reach a lost structure that has been used as a data storage for the race that once dwelled here. ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: The thing is, the way is blocked by rubbish and stone. We provided you some hammers that should be able to get you through. ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Here's the catch though, the special hammers will crumble after a time. The only way to keep them stable AND operationable is, to use them on the firelings in the cave. ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: The thing is, there ARE NO firelings in said cave. But you're in luck as if you hurt the local lavalings enough, they turn into firelings! Don't kill 'em tough ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Only when they are heated that way, they have the power to crush the rubble in the cave. ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: You might encounter other obstacles on your way and have to find a way to get past them. Perhaps detonate one of the local critters close to it ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Whatever you do though, don't set any deadly heat free or it will toast you! Oh, and if you ever catch fire, make sure to use the douser we installed. Cutting edge gnomish crystalogy! ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Sounds easy enough, eh?

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Hello! Welcome to the war soldier!

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: I wish I could accompany you on your mission but i have to stay on my post.

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Your mission is clean and simple: to kill the mega-magmaoid! ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Well, perhaps it's not clean and neither simple but I'm sure you can do it! ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Take care of his special attacks though! The bad news is, it's a LOT of damage his special attacks do! The good news is it will be spread over all that are hit by it! ...

actor_rows.name: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.speaker: GNOPS Member
actor_rows.text: Clever positioning is the key here! <he watches you> Man, you are as good as dead.

actor_rows.name: Timira
actor_rows.speaker: Timira
actor_rows.text: Oh, what ... has happened? A two-leg? What are you doing here? No, wait ... Oh, no! I attacked you, didn't I?

actor_rows.name: Timira
actor_rows.speaker: Timira
actor_rows.text: I'm so terribly sorry! I don't know what happened to me. I wasn't myself. Trapped in my own mind and body.

actor_rows.name: Timira
actor_rows.speaker: Timira
actor_rows.text: The asuri were behind it. They used dark magic to curse me. Oh, unfortunate me, how many innocent lives may I have taken? But you saved me! I feel the dark influence fading already. Thank you, noble stranger, I am forever in your debt!

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: May the mountain spirits protect and guide you.

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: I know the maharani is quite doubtful concerning her son's romantic choices. But in fact, I believe both of our people could benefit from this wedding: the mountain folk as well as the coast nagas. Alright, I will help Nihaka. ...

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: But first I need your help as well. We mountain nagas operate a highly developed observatory. But something seems to be broken. Please talk to my sister Udu, our astronomer. She can tell you what's wrong with the observatory. ...

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: And perhaps you should also talk to Tarisu, the coast nagas' shaman. He also might have a word in this.

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: May the mountain spirits protect and guide you.

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: Thank you for your help with the observatory. Now, listen. Nihaka needs to prove that this marriage is not ill-fated. He has to present two things that we consider good omens for a wedding: a coral vow flower and a damselfly.

actor_rows.name: Kaumudi
actor_rows.speaker: Kaumudi
actor_rows.text: Greetings, two-leg.

actor_rows.name: Kaumudi
actor_rows.speaker: Kaumudi
actor_rows.text: The Moon Goddess be praised, the maharani sent help! Yes, it's true, some of our eggs were stolen. What kind of monster could do such a cruel thing? Well, I'm afraid, I know all too well: The asuri have them! ...

actor_rows.name: Kaumudi
actor_rows.speaker: Kaumudi
actor_rows.text: I'm quite sure about this. But unfortunately I have no idea where the eggs could be right now. Perhaps, the mountain spirits might help. You should talk to our shaman Vrisaki.

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: May the mountain spirits protect and guide you.

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: The mountain spirits could know where the eggs are. But the asuri are powerful and even the spirits are cautious if it comes to those demons. We need something to strengthen the spirits so that they must not fear to spy on the asuri. ...

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: Bring the fur of a parder as a sign of protection against the frostflower asuri's cold. Bring the glowing feather of a dawn canary as a sign of protection against the midnight asuri's darkness. ...

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: And finally, you have to carve a flower sculpture out of an ice cube as a sign of resistance against the dawnfire asuri's flames. You can create such a delicate sculpture only with an icicle chisle, though. ...

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: Here, take mine. With the spirits' help I can craft myself another one.

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: May the mountain spirits protect and guide you.

actor_rows.name: Vrisaki
actor_rows.speaker: Vrisaki
actor_rows.text: The mountain spirits are powerful enough now. Wait ... let me focus ... Yes, they are sending me a vision. The stolen eggs are in a secret room deep down in the sunken temple of the Moon Goddess.

actor_rows.name: Kaumudi
actor_rows.speaker: Kaumudi
actor_rows.text: Greetings, two-leg.

actor_rows.name: Kaumudi
actor_rows.speaker: Kaumudi
actor_rows.text: You saved our precious babies! Thank you so much! I'm so happy I can't even ... But wait ... what's this? One of the nests began to hatch whilst in your care. Well, that will be ... interesting. ...

actor_rows.name: Kaumudi
actor_rows.speaker: Kaumudi
actor_rows.text: You have to know, naga hatchlings get imprinted on the first person they see after hatching from their eggs. In this case ... you. I'm afraid they won't accept anyone else anymore. ...

actor_rows.name: Kaumudi
actor_rows.speaker: Kaumudi
actor_rows.text: You are their hatch-mother now ... uhm, caretaker if you like. Please, take good care of our little ones, my friend.

rows.text: Human! The ancient spirits are in unrest.
I have felt tremors in the spirit wind. Whispers, cold as moonlit stone, rising from the dragon graveyard. The ancestors there do not rest. ...
Something stirs their ancient souls. Such unrest is not born without cause. ...
I hunted the cause to its root, but the root lies beyond my reach. But here my travels came to an end. The source seems to be at a place that I can't visit, beyond a threshold I cannot cross. ...
The dragon cemetery is a place most sacred. Its bones are heavy with ancient breath, and we, the scaled children, dare not tread upon that hallowed ground. ...
To us, its silence is forbidden. Only echoes of wrath linger there. ...
Yet shadows coil amidst the graves. Sinister forces stir, where none should dwell. Something desecrates the slumber of the old dragons. ...
Are you willing to assist me in my quest and travel where the scaled children can't? Yes or no?
Take this totem. Through it, the elder spirits may heed your call, and through it, you may speak to me, wherever your steps may lead. ...
It is a vessel of communion, a bridge across realms. Guard it well, for it is both your voice and mine. ...
Should you misplace the totem, I may weave another. But every carving saps my strength and the essence of rare offerings. You must repay what is spent. ...
Go, tread upon the bones of the mighty, and learn what disturbs the spirits of the old dragons. ...
Before their wrath bleeds into our world.
Ah, the unscaled adventurer! I know, you are here to talk about our mission or have you lost your talisman?
You are now prepared to face the vile necromancer. Imbued with the souls of the ancients, you should be able to free them from whatever the necromancer has trapped them in. ...
I prepared my canoe with ancient magic, to find its way through the spirit mists that shroud and protect the isle.. ...
If you are ready to face the threat, just ask me for a passage.
Do you want to use my canoe for a passage to draconia? Yes or no?
Safe travels.
Ah, the unscaled adventurer! I know, you are here to talk about our mission or have you lost your talisman?
You vanquished the eldritch necromantic evil! The ancestor spirits are at peace once again. I am grateful for what you accomplished on my behalf. Please allow me to grant you a reward.
I will grant you one of the vile necromantic runes, that I found in my quest. The dragon ancestor on the cemetery might reward you for its destruction. Are you ready to receive it? Yes or no?
Here is your reward, my unscaled friend and with it come the boons of the ancestors. ...
The talisman I bestowed upon you shall grant you a small share of their grave each fortnight.
